interactive.label: search_tools
interactive.tooltip: Filter the decay-analysis tools by their name or purpose.

interactive.label: 1. IRF Estimation
interactive.tooltip: Estimate instrument response functions from fluorescence decays.

interactive.label: 2. MaxEnt MEM
interactive.tooltip: Run maximum entropy lifetime and FRET-distance analysis.

interactive.label: 3. Lazy Lifetime Analysis *
interactive.tooltip: Analyze TCSPC decays with the LLTF workflow. (marked * : experimental, see the banner)

interactive.label: 4. Histogram-Microtime
interactive.tooltip: Build TTTR microtime histograms.

interactive.label: 5. VV/VH G-Factor
interactive.tooltip: Calculate detector G-factors from VV/VH decays.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous tool in the order the analyses depend on each other.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the next tool in the order the analyses depend on each other.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Read the calibration conventions and the limits of the linked mixing estimate.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the fast and slow references, the tail region and the export.

interactive.label: 📂 Load Decay
interactive.tooltip: Load a measured decay from a VV/VH file (.dat): the VV channel is used, the time per channel comes from the file.

interactive.label: 📊  Load from Dataset
interactive.tooltip: Choose a decay curve already open in ChiSurf; grouped datasets list each channel.

interactive.label: 💾  Save IRF
interactive.tooltip: Save the estimated IRF as a VV/VH file with identical VV and VH channels.

interactive.label: 🚀  Transfer to ChiSurf
interactive.tooltip: Register the estimated IRF as a TCSPC VV/VH dataset (g = 1, 10 MHz) in ChiSurf.

interactive.label: 📖  Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading a decay, subtracting the background and estimating the IRF.

interactive.label: ❓  Help
interactive.tooltip: What blind IRF estimation does, its assumptions and its failure modes.

interactive.label: dt
interactive.tooltip: Time per channel in nanoseconds, set from the data. Correct it when the file carries none: the time axis, lifetime and rate are rescaled, the IRF per channel is unchanged.

interactive.label: window_length
interactive.tooltip: Savitzky-Golay filter window length (channels) used to find the decay maximum; the estimator makes it odd.

interactive.label: polyorder
interactive.tooltip: Polynomial order of the Savitzky-Golay filter.

interactive.label: rl_iterations
interactive.tooltip: Richardson-Lucy deconvolution iterations. More iterations sharpen the IRF and amplify noise: where you stop is the regularisation. Auto-update uses 50.

interactive.label: regularization
interactive.tooltip: Median filter size for regularization (1 = no regularization).

interactive.label: manual_background
interactive.tooltip: Background counts per channel subtracted before the estimate (0 = auto-estimate). Loading a file sets it to the median of the last 10 % of channels.

interactive.label: 📍  Use Range Selection
interactive.tooltip: Use only a channel range for the estimate: drag the green region in the plot or type its first and last channel.

interactive.label: 🔄  Auto-Update IRF
interactive.tooltip: Re-estimate the IRF (50 RL iterations) when a parameter, the background or the range changes, once an IRF exists.

interactive.label: 🔮  Estimate IRF
interactive.tooltip: Fit the decay tail with a truncated exponential, then deconvolve it with Richardson-Lucy to obtain the IRF.

interactive.label: 📂  Load Decay
interactive.tooltip: Load a measured decay from a VV/VH file (.dat): the VV channel is used, the time per channel comes from the file.

interactive.label: Run MEM
interactive.tooltip: Solve the maximum-entropy inversion in an isolated, cancellable process.

interactive.label: L-curve
interactive.tooltip: Run the 16-point nu sweep and pick the discrete corner.

interactive.label: Sample
interactive.tooltip: Run Q-MCMC sampling of the distribution and save chains, summaries and project metadata in a folder.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Export the distribution, observed and fitted curves, IRF, weighted residuals and metadata.

interactive.label: Cancel job
interactive.tooltip: Terminate the MEM or sampling process this window started.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: List the datasets and fits of this running ChiSurf session.

interactive.label: Load decay
interactive.tooltip: Load a measured two-column time/counts decay from a file.

interactive.label: IRF file
interactive.tooltip: Load a measured instrument response and resample it onto the decay time axis.

interactive.label: Clear IRF
interactive.tooltip: Drop the measured IRF: use the response of the live fit, or an impulse.

interactive.label: Prior
interactive.tooltip: Use a vector or axis/value prior for the current distribution grid.

interactive.label: Donor
interactive.tooltip: Load the amplitude/lifetime pairs of the donor-only decay (FRET mode).

interactive.label: JSON
interactive.tooltip: Inspect and edit the declared preferences as JSON.

interactive.label: nu
interactive.tooltip: Entropy regularization weight: small values fit the noise, large ones smooth the distribution.

interactive.label: max_iter
interactive.tooltip: Maximum iterations of the compiled MEM solver.

interactive.label: tau_min
interactive.tooltip: Smallest lifetime of the grid (set from the IRF width when data is taken from a fit).

interactive.label: tau_max
interactive.tooltip: Largest lifetime of the grid.

interactive.label: tau_bins
interactive.tooltip: Number of grid points.

interactive.label: Periodic convolution
interactive.tooltip: Include repeated excitation pulses instead of a single-shot decay.

interactive.label: period
interactive.tooltip: Pulse separation used with periodic convolution (initialised from the decay window).

interactive.label: timeshift
interactive.tooltip: Response shift in histogram channels.

interactive.label: background
interactive.tooltip: Constant decay background.

interactive.label: irf_background
interactive.tooltip: Response baseline; zero selects the automatic baseline estimate.

interactive.label: lamp_scatter
interactive.tooltip: Fixed amplitude of scattered excitation light.

interactive.label: Fit nuisance (ts/bg/IRF BG)
interactive.tooltip: Let the solver fit the timeshift, background and IRF background whose fix switches are off.

interactive.label: fix timeshift
interactive.tooltip: Hold the timeshift at its value during nuisance optimization.

interactive.label: fix background
interactive.tooltip: Hold the background at its value during nuisance optimization.

interactive.label: fix IRF background
interactive.tooltip: Hold the IRF background at its value during nuisance optimization.

interactive.label: L-curve span and sampling
interactive.tooltip: The decades the L-curve sweep covers and the Q-MCMC sampling options.

interactive.label: 📖  Guide
interactive.tooltip: A walk through queueing files, choosing the detector, computing and exporting.

interactive.label: ❓  Help
interactive.tooltip: Histogram, burst-gate, shift and transfer conventions.

interactive.label: decay_file
interactive.tooltip: Measured two-column decay: time (ns) and counts.

interactive.label: Load...
interactive.tooltip: Choose the decay file.

interactive.label: irf_file
interactive.tooltip: Measured two-column instrument response: time (ns) and counts.

interactive.label: Load...
interactive.tooltip: Choose the irf file.

interactive.label: config_file
interactive.tooltip: The LLTF YAML configuration: fit range, background, IRF shift, starting values, pile-up. Edit… opens it; the next run uses the edited text.

interactive.label: Edit...
interactive.tooltip: Open the configuration in the YAML editor (load another, edit, save).

interactive.label: output_dir
interactive.tooltip: Where <decay>_fit.json and <decay>_fit.png are written (the decay's folder when empty).

interactive.label: Select...
interactive.tooltip: Choose the output directory.

interactive.label: n_lifetimes
interactive.tooltip: Exponential components of the fit. Used when Find Optimal is off; it then also switches the configuration file's own find_optimal off.

interactive.label: Find Optimal
interactive.tooltip: Find the optimal number of lifetimes: fit 1 … Max Lifetimes components and pick a count by the probability test. Read the χ²ᵣ sequence (Analysis Output, or optimal_fitting in the JSON) rather than taking the count as a verdict.

interactive.label: max_lifetimes
interactive.tooltip: Largest component count the search fits.

interactive.label: prob_threshold
interactive.tooltip: Probability a further component must reach to be kept. At the default 0.68 it needs about a 14 % drop in reduced χ², whatever the photon count.

interactive.label: Verbose Output
interactive.tooltip: Print the fitter's progress and diagnostics in Analysis Output.

interactive.label: ▶  Fit
interactive.tooltip: Run the LLTF command line in a background process with these inputs and options; needs a decay and an IRF.

interactive.label: ⏹  Stop
interactive.tooltip: Terminate the running fit; its captured output stays in Analysis Output.

interactive.label: Information
interactive.tooltip: Show workflow guidance.

interactive.label: Analysis Output
interactive.tooltip: Inspect live stdout and stderr from the fitting process.

interactive.label: Results
interactive.tooltip: Inspect fitted lifetimes, fit statistics and exports.

interactive.label: ▶  Compute
interactive.tooltip: Read the selected photons and burst gates in a background worker.

interactive.label: 💾  Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the current shifted cumulative VV/VH decay to Output.

interactive.label: Save as…
interactive.tooltip: Choose another decay filename.

interactive.label: Transfer to ChiSurf
interactive.tooltip: Save and add a TCSPC dataset with the current G-factor, time step and polarization.

interactive.label: Autosave after compute
interactive.tooltip: Write the cumulative decay to Output once the computation succeeds.

interactive.label: ➕  Files…
interactive.tooltip: Queue TTTR/PTO photon files, with per-file inclusion controls.

interactive.label: 📁  Folder…
interactive.tooltip: Queue photon files recursively from a folder.

interactive.label: 🗄  Database…
interactive.tooltip: Select raw photon data from the MMFDB object store.

interactive.label: All
interactive.tooltip: Include every file of this list.

interactive.label: None
interactive.tooltip: Exclude every file of this list.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected file from the list (it stays on disk).

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove every file of this list and the computed histogram.

interactive.label: Burst selections (BID/BUR)
interactive.tooltip: Restrict the photons to bursts: queue .bst/.bur photon-index files (inclusive bounds).

interactive.label: parallel_text
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated routing channels of the parallel (VV) stream; choosing a detector fills them.

interactive.label: perpendicular_text
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated routing channels of the perpendicular (VH) stream; empty when polarization resolution is off.

interactive.label: Polarization resolved
interactive.tooltip: Split the detector channels into alternating VV/VH routes; unchecked gives one unpolarized stream.

interactive.label: dt_ns
interactive.tooltip: Nanoseconds per binned TAC channel; reading derives it from the header. Typing a value keeps it (Manual time step).

interactive.label: Manual time step
interactive.tooltip: Keep the entered time step instead of the file header's resolution.

interactive.label: g_factor
interactive.tooltip: Weights VH by 2G in the combined VV + 2G VH trace.

interactive.label: vv_shift
interactive.tooltip: Pad or clip the VV histogram by this many bins; photon times are not wrapped.

interactive.label: vh_shift
interactive.tooltip: Pad or clip the VH histogram by this many bins; photon times are not wrapped.

interactive.label: output
interactive.tooltip: Single-column export: VV bins followed by VH bins, compatible with read_vv_vh.

interactive.label: Log counts
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide this trace group, or change the intensity scale.

interactive.label: VV
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the cumulative parallel decay.

interactive.label: VH
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the cumulative perpendicular decay.

interactive.label: VV + 2G VH
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide the combined decay.

interactive.label: Fast reference...
interactive.tooltip: Load the fast-rotating reference dye VV/VH decay used for the tail-matching G calibration.

interactive.label: Slow protein...
interactive.tooltip: Load the slow-rotating protein VV/VH decay for the linked polarization-mixing estimate.

interactive.label: Export calibration JSON...
interactive.tooltip: Export values, uncertainty, mixing diagnostics and scientific settings.

interactive.label: Archive reference calibration
interactive.tooltip: Register the raw reference decay, corrected traces, anisotropy and calibration provenance through the MMFDB RPC.

interactive.label: Stop
interactive.tooltip: Discard the pending result; an archival already running may finish.

interactive.label: Flip VV/VH
interactive.tooltip: The file has VV and VH swapped: exchange the parallel and perpendicular channels consistently across the calculation and the plots.

interactive.label: Background correction
interactive.tooltip: Subtract separate channel means of the background region before matching the tails.

interactive.label: tail_start
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin of the tail region used to match the reference dye channels.

interactive.label: tail_stop
interactive.tooltip: Last TAC bin of the tail region.

interactive.label: background_start
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin of the signal-free region used for each channel's background (needs Background correction).

interactive.label: background_stop
interactive.tooltip: Last TAC bin of the background region (needs Background correction).

interactive.label: shift
interactive.tooltip: Shift the VH time axis by this many TAC bins, fractional bins included (the Qt tool's 'Shift Perpendicular Decay').

interactive.label: Manual G
interactive.tooltip: Use the G-factor typed below instead of the calculated one (the Qt tool does this when its G field is edited).

interactive.label: g_override
interactive.tooltip: Positive detector sensitivity ratio used for the corrected anisotropy.

interactive.label: fp_dt_ns
interactive.tooltip: Nanoseconds per slow-reference bin.

interactive.label: fp_rho_ns
interactive.tooltip: Rotational correlation time used in the Perrin relation.

interactive.label: fp_r0
interactive.tooltip: Limiting (fundamental) anisotropy of the reference fluorophore.

interactive.label: Manual lifetime
interactive.tooltip: Override the intensity first-moment lifetime of the slow reference.

interactive.label: tau_override
interactive.tooltip: Lifetime used in place of the estimate.

interactive.label: Manual target rS
interactive.tooltip: Override the Perrin steady-state anisotropy target.

interactive.label: rs_override
interactive.tooltip: Steady-state anisotropy the slow reference should have.

interactive.label: Manual l1 = l2
interactive.tooltip: Override the single linked polarization-mixing parameter.

interactive.label: l_override
interactive.tooltip: Linked mixing parameter applied to l1 and l2.

interactive.label: Fast reference
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide this trace group, or change the intensity scale.

interactive.label: Slow reference
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide this trace group, or change the intensity scale.

interactive.label: Raw
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide this trace group, or change the intensity scale.

interactive.label: Corrected
interactive.tooltip: Show or hide this trace group, or change the intensity scale.
